name: agent-walkthrough
description: Agent-written code walkthroughs you review step by step in VS Code.

plugins.name: agent-walkthrough
plugins.description: The walkthrough skill: at the end of a session Claude writes .walkthrough/<session>.yaml (the changed code in execution order), and applies review feedback from the Agent Walkthrough VS Code extension.

plugins.name: agent-walkthrough-stop-hook
plugins.description: Optional: makes Claude write a walkthrough before it finishes any session that changed code. Best installed per project.
